tape_metadata.boundary_convention: Line through tape centre along its long axis; tape width is not subtracted

region.interpretation: Rectangle bounded by the four green tape long-axis centre lines; entire cube footprint stays inside

protocol.placement_boundary: Four rectangle edges are marker long-axis lines through their centres, not a hull of marker centres
protocol.color_distribution: balanced random permutation; 20 per color for 100 episodes
protocol.material_note: Approximate linear RGB colors; only diffuse color changes
protocol.success: Existing physical PAP outcome: lift, full containment, release, floor rest, stable 0.5 s, bilateral contact history
protocol.timeout_rule: No physical success by 20 simulated seconds is failure
protocol.invalid_action_rule: Invalid model actions count as failures
protocol.infrastructure_error_rule: Infrastructure errors invalidate completion; report separately without claiming 100 episodes
protocol.diffusion_noise: Native model sampling; no per-request generator seed override
